AND THE SEMANTICS THAT MATTER MORE THAN THE LIST. Every condition in CHECK_CONDITIONS is wrapped in IF IV_xxx IS NOT INITIAL. A parameter the caller leaves EMPTY SKIPS ITS CONDITION ENTIRELY. So the effective perimeter is whichever subset of the eight the caller actually supplies, two callers can get different perimeters from the same class, and nothing records which. The perimeter cannot be reproduced as a WHERE clause over the FM lines, and any measurement built that way is an approximation by construction. ONE CONDITION IS UNMEASURABLE FROM THE DATA SIDE: business area GEF is not carried on the FM line at all. claims.claim: THE BUDGET RATE FIRES AT TWELVE DISTINCT MOMENTS, AND EACH ONE APPLIES A DIFFERENT PERIMETER (s098, the twelve ZFIX enhancement sources extracted from P01 at last). HOW THEY WERE FINALLY READ. An ENHO has no program of its own; its source lives in a GENERATED INCLUDE named <ENHNAME> padded to 30 characters with '=' and closed with 'E'. ENHOBJ gives the hooked object and ENHINCINX gives the include name. With the right name, RPY_PROGRAM_READ reads it like any other program. All twelve came out — 1,154 lines. EXT-ENHO-SOURCE had stood open because the extractor skipped ENHO as unreadable; it was readable all along, under a name nobody had constructed. THE TWELVE MOMENTS, in lifecycle order: a COMMITMENT LINE is created (SAPLFMOI) · AVAILABILITY IS CHECKED (SAPLFMFC, FM_FUNDS_CHECK_FI and _OI) · a FUND IS RESERVED (FMR3, FMR3_FILL_KBFM_FROM_KBLX) · a FUND IS BLOCKED (SAPLFMFR) · EARMARKED FUNDS ARE REDUCED (CL_FM_EF_POSITION) · earmarked funds are CONSISTENCY-CHECKED (CL_FM_EF_POSITION) · the PAYMENT COMMITMENT is written (SAPLFMR_AD2) · an FI POSTING REACHES FM (SAPLFMRI) · a PBC POSITION is updated (CL_HRFPM_CD_PBC_UPDATE) · an EMPLOYEE EXPENSE is posted (BAPI_ACC_EMPLOYEE_EXP_POST) · COMMITMENTS ARE REVALUED (LFMOIF0M, LFMOIF1C) · RESERVED FUNDS ARE REVALUED (RFFMBW00). THE AVAILABILITY CHECK IS THE ONE THAT CHANGES THE MEANING. The rate is applied INSIDE FM_FUNDS_CHECK, before availability is decided — so the fixed rate is what the budget check sees. This is not a reporting adjustment applied afterwards; it changes what is allowed to post. AND NO TWO CALL SITES PASS THE SAME CONDITIONS. Seven of the eight are passed at the AVC, FI and new-item moments; six at fund reservation, fund block and earmarked-funds reduction (FIKRS derived from the company code in the last of these); and at REVALUATION — both of them — ONLY THE FUND TYPE IS PASSED. Since an unpassed parameter skips its check, revaluation carries NO currency restriction, NO business area, NO commitment item and NO business transaction. The EUR-only limit that shapes every other moment does not apply there. That is the widest gate in the solution and it is invisible from the class alone. THE STAFF PATH IS A SEPARATE MECHANISM. PBC position update and employee expense posting do not use the main perimeter: they gate through YCL_FM_BR_PBC_POSTING_BL and YCL_FM_BR_PAYROLL_POSTING_BL on the PERSONNEL NUMBER, and convert through a second method, CONVERT_TO_CURRENCY_2. ONE SMALL THING WORTH KEEPING: in the staff branch of the payment-commitment enhancement, IV_FIPEX is COMMENTED OUT — so the commitment-item exclusion of GAINS and REVENUE is deliberately not applied at that point.

EURX was set to the operational rate in force at the START OF THE BIENNIUM and then held. The fixed rate is a SNAPSHOT of the moving one, which is why the two coincide at the beginning and diverge after. AND THE OPERATIONAL RATE CROSSED IT AGAIN. Through 2024 the rate moved 1.09529 (15 Jan), 1.08460, 1.07181, 1.08342, 1.09409, 1.08225, ... and came back to exactly 1.09529 on 15 AUGUST 2024, then went above it — 1.10865, 1.11857 — before falling away through 2025 to 1.04167 and 1.02041. SO THE 2024 'BUDGET RATE' LINES ARE MOSTLY COINCIDENCE, NOT CONVERSION. My filter selected FM lines whose FKBTR/TRBTR equals the EURX rate. In 2024 that catches lines where the OPERATIONAL rate simply WAS 1.09529 that day, so FI posted at it and FM inherited it unchanged. The evidence is decisive: across all 465 route-1 pairs in 2024 the impact is EXACTLY 0.00 — FM equals FI to the cent. A real conversion cannot produce an exact zero against a moving baseline; identical amounts mean no conversion took place. THE METHOD LESSON, and it is the same shape as the EURX discovery itself: MATCHING A RATE IS NOT PROOF OF A MECHANISM when the baseline can take that value on its own. The test only separates the two when the fixed and moving rates differ — which is exactly when the impact is non-zero. An impact of exactly zero is not a small effect; it is the signature of no effect at all. claims.claim: THE PERSONNEL SIDE OF THE BUDGET RATE IS GATED BY AN HR FEATURE, AND ITS TWO-STEP CONVERSION IS DEAD CODE (s098, AN-BR-PERSONNEL-PAYROLL-SCHEMA, first pass). YCL_FM_BR_PBC_POSTING_BL:: CHECK_CONDITIONS reads PA0001, the employee's organisational assignment valid on the position's DUE_DATE, moves it into a PC205 structure and calls CL_HRPA_FEATURE=>GET_VALUE( FEATURE = 'YYCDR' ). claims.claim: WHAT CHANGES IN PRODUCTION VERSUS WHAT TRAVELS BY TRANSPORT — measured, with one object that shows what correct looks like (s098, user-directed). THE CONTRAST THAT MAKES IT READABLE. T003, the document-type configuration, has ZERO change documents in production and 8,646 TABU entries in the transport record. That is the intended pattern: changed in development, moved by transport, never touched in P01. Against it: SET maintenance has 25 changes in production and appears in ZERO transports. FMFCTR, the fund-centre master, has 18 changes in production and ZERO transports. NRINTERVAL has 111 changes in production against 14 transport appearances. IDENTITY has 38,277 changes and no transports, which is correct — users are not transported. SO TWO CONFIGURATION OBJECTS ARE MAINTAINED ONLY IN PRODUCTION: the SETS that carry every hierarchy, and the fund-centre master. Neither has ever moved through the transport path. ADIL SEFIANI — user A_SEFIANI — makes 1,547 changes in P01. The bulk is ordinary HR work: 1,053 FMRESERV and 466 PBC through PA30, which is the maintenance transaction for it. What stands out is 25 changes to NRINTERVAL — NUMBER RANGE INTERVALS, which are configuration — made through SE38, THE ABAP EDITOR, between February 2024 and June 2026. He is the only user who touches number ranges that way. Every other maintainer of the same object uses a dedicated transaction: AS08, OBH2, BUCF, FBN1, SNUM, PR10. AND THE SAME SHAPE, LARGER, ON THE IDENTITY SIDE. P.IKOUNA changes IDENTITY 3,626 times through SE38 in a three-week window in April and May 2026, alongside 4,199 through PFCG and 3,369 through SU01. The execution log names what SE38 is running: YBC_ESS_USER_MANAGEMENT, 6,230 times — a CUSTOM PROGRAM THAT HAS ITS OWN TRANSACTION, YBC_ESS_USER, which the same user also uses 2,376 times. So the program is reached both ways, and the editor route bypasses whatever the transaction's authorisation object protects. WHY SE38 IS THE SIGNAL RATHER THAN THE CRIME. Running a program through the editor is not itself wrong, and number ranges are deliberately not transported in SAP. What the measurement shows is a CHANNEL DIFFERENCE: for the same object, one user goes through the editor while every other goes through the maintenance transaction. That difference is what makes an action invisible to the controls built around the transaction — and it is detectable exactly this way, by crossing the change log's transaction code against the population of maintainers for the same object.

claims.claim: THE PAYROLL ACCOUNT DETERMINATION IS READ FROM THE DOCUMENTS, AND IT SETTLES WHERE THE ACCOUNT IS DECIDED (s098, closing the search that three extractions could not). The transaction key is the coarse FI bucket; something finer picks the account inside it, and the wage type is what varies at that granularity. That is the USER's stated model — the transaction key derived from the employee's master data, the GL account from the wage type — and the direction of the cardinality is what confirms it rather than a configuration table. An enhancement named after the account determination, on the posting path, is where any local deviation from the standard determination would live. THE METHOD POINT. claims.claim: THE PPC FRAMEWORK USES TWO DIFFERENT COUNTRIES IN TWO LAYERS, AND THAT IS WHY IT IS 'SOCGEN-ONLY' — the mechanism, not the specification. Read from source: FI_CGI_DMEE_EXIT_W_BADI (177 lines, P01) resolves lv_bank_country from FPAYHX-UBISO, falling back to FPAYHX-UBNKS — OUR house bank's country — and then does GET BADI l_badi FILTERS bank_country = lv_bank_country, credit_or_debit = <D|C>. So the implementation is selected by the country of the PAYING house bank. That is why the class is called YCL_IDFI_CGI_DMEE_FR: SOG01 is a French bank. INSIDE that class, CM002 (IF_IDFI_CGI_DMEE_COUNTRIES~GET_VALUE) calls GET_TAG_VALUE_FROM_CUSTO with IV_LAND1 = I_FPAYH-ZBNKS — the BENEFICIARY's bank country. Two countries, two layers: OUR bank picks the class, THEIR bank picks the config rows. MEASURED CONSEQUENCE: only the FR class dispatches PPC. YCL_IDFI_CGI_DMEE_DE (84 lines, for DEU01/UIL) and YCL_IDFI_CGI_DMEE_IT (84 lines, for UNI01/ICTP) implement GET_CREDIT only and never call GET_TAG_VALUE_FROM_CUSTO; nor does YCL_IDFI_CGI_DMEE_FALLBACK. Citi house banks have no implementation at all. THIS SETTLES WHETHER EGYPT NEEDS ABAP: it does not. A payment from a French house bank to an Egyptian-banked vendor enters the exit with lv_bank_country='FR', selects the FR class, and that class looks up YTFI_PPC_STRUC for LAND1='EG'. All three layers — u917's LFBK-BANKS lookup, CM002's ZBNKS pass-through and CM003's WHERE LAND1 = IV_LAND1 — are generic, with no country literal anywhere. Nine beneficiary countries already resolve through this one class. EGYPT RENDER COVERAGE, MEASURED on 2,837 lines to Egyptian-banked vendors 2024-2026: SOG01+SOG05 (FR) 2,665 = 93.9% RENDER · UNI01 (IT) 43 · CIT04/CIT19/CIT15 58 · no house bank 64 — 172 lines = 6.1% would NOT render even after EG is configured, and now the reason is known per line rather than assumed.

So WBS hierarchy nesting IS achievable via BAPI_PROJECT_MAINTAIN (MuleSoft does it daily); the only residual is reproducing the exact I_WBS_HIERARCHIE_TABLE payload MuleSoft sends. incidents.title: Budget Rate custom solution allows cross-currency consumption against EUR-reserved FR -> AVC pool drift -> FMAVC005
incidents.reporter: Laetitia Vonthron (adm.cad) -> Christina Lopez-Chemouny -> Yimiao Guo -> Illya Konakov -> Pablo Lopez
incidents.primary_subject: FR 3250117351 line 39 (EUR carryforward to 2026, fund 3110111021 / FUNDSCTR PAX / CMMTITEM TC); EqG ticket reimbursement for SG Bivini Mangue
error_messages: FMAVC005 Annual budget exceeded by 0,87 USD (FM Availability Control) for document item 00002
incidents.root_cause_summary: 15-member ZFIX_EXCHANGERATE composite has gate-input asymmetry: Camp A (FR-anchored: CHECK_CONS, EF_FUND_RESERVATION, FUNDBLOCK) always fires for EUR FRs; Camp B (posting-anchored: PAYCOMMIT, NEW_ITEM, AVC, KBLEW, FI) silently skips when posting currency is not EUR. FR persisted at BR (1.09529); consumption persisted at identity. AVC pool drifts fund-by-fund until cover-group hits zero headroom. Vonthron's fund 3110111021/PAX/TC has $12,897.80 budget exactly matched by $12,897.80 of carryforward FR commitments -> Available=0 -> any new USD posting fires FMAVC005.
code_validation_chain: extracted_code/CLAS/YCL_FM_BR_EXCHANGE_RATE_BL/CM00A line 8: APPEND 'EUR' to mr_waers (the perimeter line)
extracted_code/CLAS/YCL_FM_BR_EXCHANGE_RATE_BL/CM004: check_conditions exits abap_false if iv_waers NOT IN mr_waers
ZFIX_EXCHANGERATE_CHECK_CONS Enh1 (Camp A): iv_waers = m_r_doc->m_f_kblk-waers (FR header EUR) -> PASS -> recalc -> Enh2 RESTORE original (in-memory only, no persistence)
ZFIX_EXCHANGERATE_NEW_ITEM (Camp B): iv_waers = c_f_fmoi-twaer (USD for USD posting) -> FAIL -> no recalc
ZFIX_EXCHANGERATE_AVC Enh1+3 (Camp B): iv_waers = <ls_fmioi>-twaer / <ls_fmifiit>-twaer per-row -> mixed, USD rows skip
ZFIX_EXCHANGERATE_KBLEW (Camp B): iv_waers = ls_tr_kblew-waers (USD) -> FAIL -> no recalc
ZFIX_EXCHANGERATE_FI (Camp B): iv_waers = <ls_fmifiit>-twaer (USD) -> FAIL -> no recalc + no audit + mt_avc_fund not appended -> fmavc_reinit_on_event handler never registered
FMAVCT(RLDNR=9H,RFIKRS=UNES,RYEAR=2026,RFUND=3110111021,RFUNDSCTR=PAX,RCMMTITEM=TC) ALLOCTYPE_9=KBFC HSL01=12,897.80 USD
Open FR commitments same key: 5 lines (RFPOS 38/39/40/43/45 of FR 3250117351) summing to $12,897.80
Available = 12,897.80 - 12,897.80 = 0 -> FMAVC005 fires on any positive posting

incidents.root_cause_mechanism_detail: YTBAE002.abap:27 declares CONSTANTS: GC_MOD TYPE C VALUE 'E' (SAP CALL TRANSACTION mode 'Display errors only, opens SAPGUI on BDC error'). The program issues four CALL TRANSACTION ... USING BDCDTAB MODE GC_MOD MESSAGES INTO Y_MESSTAB inside the GET bsis / LDB_PROCESS iteration body: YTBAE002.abap:723 (FB08 reverse), :771 (F-04 post-with-clearing), :819 (FBRA reset cleared), :853 (FB08 second branch). On slow WAN paths (Maputo field office) the cumulative GUI round-trip per BDC error exceeds rdisp/max_wprun_time → dispatcher aborts with TIME_OUT at whatever SELECT the work-process is waiting in (SAPDBSDF:1983 PUT_BSIS in this case). Errors are already captured in Y_MESSTAB at each call site and persisted by PROC_RECONCIL_MESS_ADD at :754/:795/:840/:874 into GT_RECONCIL_MESS for the list output — so silent capture is already wired. Fix: change line 27 'E' → 'N'.

incidents.root_cause_summary: CONFIRMED via TIER_1 RFC pull (P01, 2026-05-01). FM-AVC engine fires (NOT PS-AVC). The AVC derivation rule FMAFMAP013500109 collapses FIPEX 10'..50 into a single AVC control object TC for fund 196EAR4042. UNESCO loads donor revenue (WRTTP=66) entirely on FIPEX=REVENUE placeholder, which falls OUTSIDE the TC derivation range. Result: TC bucket sees /usr/bin/bash revenue while ,561,651.78 of KBFC consumption lands there → pool depth -,561,651.78 → FMAVC005 "Annual budget exceeded" raised for every new SES on FIPEX 11/20 (the three incident POs all hit the TC bucket). Fund-level pool is +1.83M and PS-AVC project pool is +6.43M — both healthy — but the FM-AVC enforces at the AVC-derived bucket level, not fund level. The class is REVENUE-PLACEHOLDER vs AVC-DERIVATION-BUCKET misalignment, structural to UNESCO config, present on 1,330+457 = 1,787 buckets across UNESCO (Tier 1+2 of the misalignment classifier).

incidents.title: Ticket 180995 — two sibling transports from one ticket reached P01 101 days apart (MZ payroll currency setup)
incidents.reporter: JP Lopez (surfaced reviewing the PY-Finance companion, Session #60)
incidents.primary_subject: Transport D01K9B0CDZ (Mozambique MZN wage type 5$B3) vs sibling D01K9B0CE6 (Sri Lanka LKR 5$B4)
incidents.root_cause_summary: Not a runtime failure. Ticket 180995 required two parallel Field-Office currency setups. FP_SPEZZANO released both transports on 2024-11-19 within 6 hours of each other, structurally identical (8 table keys each: T042Z/T042ZT payment method + the 5-table wage-type chain T512T/T512W/T52DZ/T52EL/T52EZ). Sri Lanka imported to P01 the next day; Mozambique imported 2025-02-28 — a 101-day divergence. Which of the three hypotheses applies (deliberate staggered rollout / parked in the STMS queue / awaiting FO approval) cannot be separated from the data: TMSALOG is capped at ~1000 rows via RFC and the 2024-11 to 2025-02 window has cycled out. The confirmed root cause is structural, not per-transport: UNESCO has NO control that checks whether siblings of one ticket land in P01 together, and the link ticket->transport exists only as free text in E07T (no foreign key), so the divergence is invisible by construction.
code_validation_chain: E070 D01K9B0CDZ -> TRSTATUS=R TRFUNCTION=W OWNER=FP_SPEZZANO CLIENT=350 STRKORR=(empty)
E070 D01K9B0CE6 -> TRSTATUS=R TRFUNCTION=W OWNER=FP_SPEZZANO CLIENT=350 STRKORR=(empty)
E07T D01K9B0CDZ -> '180995/ Creat Payment Method Mozambic'; D01K9B0CE6 -> '180995 - Payment Method U with currency LKR'
E071K D01K9B0CDZ -> 8 keys: T042Z 350 MZ 3 / T042ZT 350 E MZ 3 / T512T 350 E UN 5$B3 / T512W / T52DZ / T52EL x2 / T52EZ
E071K D01K9B0CE6 -> 8 keys, symmetric: T042Z 350 LK U / T042ZT 350 E LK U / T512T 350 E UN 5$B4 / T512W / T52DZ / T52EL x2 / T52EZ
STRKORR empty on both -> neither is a correction of the other (a correction references its parent there)
TMSALOG snapshot 2026-04-20 -> V.VAURETTE is the exclusive human P01 import operator (TMS_TP_IMPORT); historical rows cycled out

scope.exposure_window: 2024-11-20 to 2025-02-28 — Sri Lanka live in P01, Mozambique not, despite same-day release
scope.pattern: every new Field Office pay currency needs a 5$Bx wage type plus a country payment method

fix_path.immediate: None for these transports — both are in P01 and effective since 2025-02-28.
fix_path.structural: The ticket->transport link must stop being free text. Cluster transports by the ticket number parsed from E07T (^\d{5,7}) so sibling bundles are a first-class object in the transport companion.
preventive: Build a TR-sibling-lag detector under Zagentexecution/quality_checks/ — same ticket in as4text, import-date delta > 7 days
Extend the transport companion to group TRs by ticket number
Governance: when a ticket produces more than one TR, cross-check sibling status at each release (ready? released? queued?)
Document the 5$Bx new-country wage-type procedure in the PY-Finance companion (done in v1)

side_findings: P01 import depends on a single basis operator (V.VAURETTE) — queue stalls have no Finance-side visibility
Treasury-owned PY config via service desk is a legitimate cross-functional flow, not a misclassification
A 101-day lag is not automatically a defect — it may be a deliberate staggered rollout; needs a human to confirm
lessons: Ticket-linked transports can diverge silently — this is a class of defect, not a one-off.
The service-desk ticket number is the best cross-cutting key linking transports to business context, but it survives only as E07T regex.
When the log needed to decide between hypotheses has cycled out, say so and name the human who can close it — do not pick a hypothesis.

incidents.title: ABAP class loss/corruption on D01 caused by our own ADT-over-RFC write client (June 2026)
incidents.reporter: JP Lopez — 'Claude processes deleted class definitions, at least 14 lost' (2026-06-12)
incidents.primary_subject: 4 FI classes damaged on D01 by in-place ADT writes; 14 N_MENARD classes used as live write-test targets
error_messages: ResourceNotFound (ADT write against an already-deleted object)
incidents.root_cause_summary: A write-capable ADT-over-RFC client built 2026-06-07 wrote and activated EXISTING D01 classes in place — no transport, no review, and on objects we do not own (N_MENARD's). Two corruption paths, both proven from the client's own source: (1) lossy read-then-restore — read_source() falls back to CLIF_GET_SOURCE via RFC_ABAP_INSTALL_AND_RUN with WRITE:/ lv where lv is c(255), so the readback is truncated at 255 chars per line and carries report headings; writing that back as the 'restore' mangles the class; (2) writing to a class with missing/invalid SEOCLASS metadata leaves it unrecoverable — the client's own docstring records this, meaning the SEOCLASS pre-flight guard was added AFTER the damage. The deeper cause is process, not code: a RELEASED transport is the unit of change, and in-place ADT writing bypasses it entirely.
code_validation_chain: sap_adt_rfc_client.py (created 2026-06-07 12:36) deploy() = lock -> write_source(/source/main) -> syntax -> unlock -> activate
probe_deploy_real_change.py (2026-06-07 12:21) = read -> modify -> write -> activate -> 'restore' original (restore failure leaves the class emptied)
read_source() fallback CLIF_GET_SOURCE via RFC_ABAP_INSTALL_AND_RUN, WRITE:/ lv with lv TYPE c(255) -> truncated readback
deploy() docstring: 'Writing to a class with missing SEOCLASS leaves it in unrecoverable state (learned D01 2026-06-07)'
TS2 baseline (pre-Jun-7 copy of D01) used as discriminator: healthy-in-TS2/V01 but broken-in-D01 = OUR damage
TADIR present + SEOCLASS absent for the other ~11/41 = pre-existing intentional deletions (debris), NOT loss
Recovery: transport of copies V01K910259, V01 -> D01, same transport domain DOMAIN_P01, 'Overwrite Originals', target client 350
Post-recovery SEOCLASSDF state=1 for all recovered classes; method counts match baseline (32 / 1 / 54); VRSD version history survived the deletion

real_damage: YCL_FI_ACC_DOCUMENT_ARGA (V01 version is a thin stub — that IS the correct released state)
scope.not_our_damage: 11 N_MENARD TADIR-orphans predating 2026-06-07 (legitimate prior deletions); the Jun-7 writes hit already-dead objects, producing the ResourceNotFound errors
scope.false_panic: a later broad orphan scan flagged ~41 'broken' classes — resolved by evidence: TADIR-without-SEOCLASS is deletion debris, not lost code
scope.systems: D01 (172.16.4.66 client 350) only — NO P01 impact found

fix_path.immediate: Recovered all 4 via transport of copies from V01 (same transport domain, 'Overwrite Originals', target client 350) — never via ADT write. Verified line-for-line against V01.
fix_path.structural: Promoted the disciplined change process from CRP to an ecosystem-universal standard (ecosystem-coordinator/.knowledge/way-of-working/sap-abap-change-discipline.md, BROADCAST-007) and ported the gated write path to Zagentexecution/abap_deploy/deploy_object.py: own-objects-only manifest, TADIR/SEOCLASS pre-flight, PRE-readback, hard diff-gate that HALTs on deletions, operator guard, concurrent-writer guard, POST-readback byte-verify. verify_mirror.py keeps the git mirror 0-diff and the process-guardian agent HALTs a close that deployed without that evidence.
preventive: Both ADT write clients kill-switched behind ALLOW_D01_WRITES=1 — a blunt block, to be retired once transport RELEASE + ATC-via-REST are the path (H59)
Own Z*/Y* objects only — NEVER peer-team objects, in any system
Recover deleted objects via transport of copies, never by writing them back
Verify the source system shares the target's transport domain (TMSCSYS) before attempting recovery — a cross-domain system gives 'target unknown'

side_findings: SE24/SE80 version-retrieve does NOT work for a fully deleted class, but VRSD version history survives a SEOCLASS deletion
Without 'Overwrite Originals' the import silently skips the object when the target is the class's home system

YCL_FI_ACC_DOCUMENT_ARGA's real CHANGE logic was never-transported WIP living only in TS2 — not lost and not our damage; ARGA is superseded anyway (live enhancement YFI_ENH_ACC_DOCUMENT_ARGA uses YFI_ENH_DOWNPAYMENT)
lessons: A RELEASED transport is the unit of change — D01 is DEV, not 'the deploy'.
Never use another team's objects as test targets. Own Z*/Y* only.
Verify content before alarming: TADIR-orphan is not lost code, and a broad scan without a baseline manufactures a panic.
A guard added after the lesson does not protect the objects damaged before it — the pre-flight must exist before the first write.

incidents.title: Add Egypt to the mandatory purpose-of-payment country list (Citi CBE requirement, effective 2026-09-05)
incidents.reporter: Mathewos Mehari (BFM) via Christina Lopez-Chemouny; originating notice from Citibank Egypt 2026-07-12
incidents.primary_subject: Country EG in the purpose-of-payment configuration
incidents.root_cause_summary: Not a defect. Regulatory change: Citibank Egypt requires Purpose of Payment on all RTGS and Cross-Border Funds Transfers to/from Egypt from 2026-09-05, in the Transaction Details field or SWIFT Field 70. UNESCO already runs a purpose-code framework for 9 countries; Egypt has to be added to it. The work is configuration in three maintained tables, zero ABAP.
authority: Citibank Egypt notice, 2026-07-12 — 'payment instructions ... which do not include Purpose of Payment will not be processed', effective 2026-09-05
Request from Mathewos Mehari 2026-08-10: 'include this with the list of the countries which need this information'
code_validation_chain: Citi notice names SWIFT Field 70 -> ISO 20022 RmtInf/Ustrd -> YTFI_PPC_TAG TAG_ID='USTRD' (the family BH/ID/IN/JO/MA/MY/PH use), NOT INSTRINF (= SWIFT :72, used by AE/CN)
YRGGBS00:1547-1590 FORM u917 -> SELECT ytfi_ppc_struc WHERE land1 = <LFBK-BANKS> AND ppc_code IN ('PPC_VAR','PPC_DESCR') -> b_result = b_false: the row type IS the switch
YCL_IDFI_CGI_DMEE_UTIL::GET_TAG_VALUE_FROM_CUSTO:91-169 -> block semantics; T015L-ZWCK1 SPLIT AT SPACE: PPC_VAR = first word, PPC_DESCR = the rest
P01 GB931 -> VALID='UNES' has 12 steps, u917 is 012; no other institute's validation can contain it -> capture reaches company code UNES only

P01 T042E UNES/3 -> ZFORN='Y110_PRENUM_CHCK' no PMW; T042Z FR/3 = manual pre-numbered cheque PROGN=RFFOUS_C XSCHK='X'; REGUT and PAYR have no row for the 5 most recent Egypt runs -> no SAP payment file on this path
u917 body contains ZERO occurrences of yxuser/xtype -> the super-user bypass does NOT apply to this control (only U913 among the 8 blocking routines carries it)

scope.population_bound_by_citi: 387 REGUH lines settling at an Egyptian bank (UBNKS='EG'), 100% company code UNES / house bank CIT19 / method 3
scope.wider_population: 17,778 lines to Egypt-domiciled payees: UNES 16,058 · ICTP 1,242 · UIL 348 · IIEP 117 · UIS 9 · UBO 4

fix_path.immediate: Three maintained tables, no ABAP: (1) YTFI_PPC_STRUC rows for LAND1='EG', TAG_ID='USTRD', DEB_CRE='C' — pay type O carries PPC_VAR + PPC_DESCR + PAY_FIELD FPAYP-XBLNR (PPC_DESCR is the load-bearing block because Citi asks for a narrative, not a code); pay types P and R carry FIXED_VAL. (2) T015L EG* entries, ZWCK1 = '<code> <narrative>'. (3) YTFI_PPC_TAG one row EG/USTRD/C -> RmtInf/Ustrd.
fix_path.structural: Decide whether ICTP/IIEP/UBO/UIL/UIS get an equivalent step in their own validation — KU-2026-099-INSTITUTE-COVERAGE.
preventive: Configuring Egypt buys the CAPTURE only: this payment path emits no SAP file, so the actual instruction is issued outside SAP and someone must populate the Purpose of Payment there — KU-2026-099-EGYPT-INSTRUCTION-CHANNEL
Confirm with CitiService Egypt whether a code prefix is wanted or narrative only
Agree the T015L reason list with BFM/Treasury — it is UNESCO's own taxonomy worded to Citi's standard, not a bank-issued code list

open_followups: T015L reason list — BUSINESS INPUT from BFM/Treasury, blocks entry
Code prefix or narrative only — ask CitiService Egypt
Who fills the Purpose of Payment in the bank portal before 2026-09-05 — Treasury + Cairo office
Whether the other five institutes get the control — Marlies Spronk + N_MENARD + Pablo Lopez
side_findings: The request as phrased ('add Egypt to the list of mandatory purpose code countries') is correct; the list is YTFI_PPC_STRUC and the switch is a PPC_VAR/PPC_DESCR row
The control keys on the vendor's BANK country (LFBK-BANKS), not the address country
This path produces no payment file at all, so the rendering half of the framework is moot for Egypt
lessons: The bank's own notice decided the structure: naming SWIFT Field 70 fixes the tag family to RmtInf/Ustrd and removes the only structural choice there was.
A regulatory request that asks for a 'description' is not a code-list request — Egypt is a PPC_DESCR country, not a PPC_VAR one.
Capture and rendering must be reasoned about separately: a country can need the first and have no use for the second.

U_USAGE.question: WHAT objects actually execute, WHO runs them, by which CHANNEL (dialog / batch / RFC-BAPI / batch-input BDC), WHEN, and at what VOLUME — the AS-RUN execution footprint?
U_USAGE.method: Fuse the execution-evidence channels into a per-domain object×actor×channel×time×volume census: RSAU/SM20 audit (Transaction Start->tcode, Report Start->program, RFC Function Call->function) + TBTCO/TBTCP (batch program+variant) + APQI/APQD (batch input / BDC). Cross-reference the static catalog (TSTC / TFDIR) to split EXECUTED vs CATALOG-ONLY. Builder: process_mining/fm_executed_census.py (generalize per domain via the FM-style name filter). Scored: NONE=no census; PARTIAL=one channel or counts-only; HAVE=all 4 channels with actor+volume(+time).
U_USAGE.note: The AS-RUN usage layer. Distinct from B_CODE (STATIC: which code exists), A_PROCESS (the FLOW/variants) and E_AUTH (who CAN execute). U_USAGE = who ACTUALLY executes what, how, when, how much. Bridges static inventory -> live reality; the dead-vs-used signal also feeds R_S4_READINESS (used-to-migrate vs dead-to-delete). For FM lines that fall inside the eight-dimension perimeter — ledger 9A, company UNES, FM area UNES, business area GEF, currency EUR, commitment item excluding GAINS and REVENUE, transaction excluding HRM1/HRM2/HRP1, fund type among the 14 flagged ZZFIX_RATE — compare the rate implied by the posted amounts against the standard rate for the same date. The difference is the mechanism's effect.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.method: select fmifiit_full on the perimeter, derive the implied rate per line from the transaction and local amounts, and compare with TCURR for the posting date
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.why_it_matters: every statement we hold about the budget rate is still about design. This is the only route left to its effect, now that the shadow-ledger route is known not to exist
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.result: the perimeter is measured and the record table covers it at 99.8% in 2025. What is still not measured is the AMOUNT effect — ZFKBTR against what the standard rate would have given.

analysis_tasks_no_extraction.task: The budget rate was activated from 20240101 by TVARVC and the 2024 perimeter holds 10,660 FM lines, yet YTFM_BR_FMIFIIT has ZERO rows for 2024 and its earliest processing stamp is 2025-01-13. Establish which happened: the recording table was created in 2025 and the mechanism ran unrecorded through 2024, or the mechanism did not run at all in its first declared year. Anyone reconciling 2024 needs the answer and the two cases have opposite consequences.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.method: check the creation date of YTFM_BR_FMIFIIT in TADIR and its transport, then compare 2024 posted rates inside the perimeter against TCURR for the same dates
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.why_it_matters: a year of the mechanism is either unrecorded or did not happen
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.result: the mechanism DID run in 2024, on 7.6% of the perimeter (740 of 9,737 lines), reaching 94.7% in 2025. The control table's emptiness in 2024 said nothing about it.

analysis_tasks_no_extraction.task: The fixed rate is known: 1.0416667. What is not known is which field the enhancements write it to. Eliminated by measurement: the FKBTR-to-TRBTR relationship in fmifiit_full (it appears less often inside the perimeter than outside) and the EUR budget in bpja (all at rate 1.0). Remaining candidates worth testing in order: the FI document — BSEG second local currency DMBE2, which the BI extractor already reads for USD — then the commitment lines in fmioi, then the reporting layer alone, which would mean the mechanism never touches a posting at all.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.method: test DMBE2 against the fixed rate for the same documents the control table names; the 12,396 matched FM lines give an exact document list to join on
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.why_it_matters: the whole budget-rate question reduces to this. Everything else about the mechanism — perimeter, gates, defects — is known
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.result: the FM ledger, via exchange rate type EURX at 1.09529. 94.7% of the 2025 perimeter against 0.09% outside it. FI/GL stays on the standard rate by design, and the FM-minus-FI difference is the reported impact.

analysis_tasks_no_extraction.task: The impact is defined as FM minus FI/GL. Both sides are now identifiable: FM lines carrying EURX inside the perimeter, and their FI counterparts through KNBELNR/KNGJAHR/KNBUZEI plus BUKRS. Compute the difference in money, by year and by fund, and reconcile it against what the constant-dollar reports state. That number is what the organisation calls the budget-rate impact.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.method: join fmifiit_full perimeter lines at EURX to bseg_union on (BUKRS, KNBELNR, KNGJAHR, KNBUZEI) and difference FKBTR against DMBTR
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.why_it_matters: everything about the mechanism is now known except the one number it exists to produce

analysis_tasks_no_extraction.task: Every condition in CHECK_CONDITIONS is skipped when its parameter arrives empty, so the effective perimeter is set by the CALLER and not by the class. Enumerate the call sites — the 12 ZFIX enhancements plus the five other BR classes — and record, per call site, which of the eight parameters it supplies. That table IS the real perimeter, and it is the only way to know which postings the mechanism can reach.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.method: grep the call sites of CHECK_CONDITIONS and CONVERT_TO_CURRENCY across package YA and the enhancements, and read the actual argument list at each
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.why_it_matters: the difference between 'the class defines a perimeter' and 'each caller defines its own' is the difference between a rule and a convention
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.result: twelve moments, twelve perimeters. 7 conditions at AVC/FI/new-item, 6 at reservation/block/reduction, and ONLY the fund type at both revaluation paths — which means revaluation has no currency or business-area limit at all. The staff path gates on PERNR through a different class.

analysis_tasks_no_extraction.task: In 2024 the 740 perimeter lines at EURX pair to FI lines carrying the SAME 1.09529 rate, so FM and FI agree and the impact is exactly zero — unlike 2025 and 2026 where FI runs on a moving rate. Establish why: documents entered with EURX on both legs, a year-end revaluation, or the mechanism working differently in its first partial year.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.method: compare document types and entry transactions for the 2024 pairs against the 2025 ones
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.why_it_matters: a year where the impact is structurally zero is either correct or a gap
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.result: EURX is the UN operational rate FROZEN at the start of the biennium — the operational rate itself was 1.09529 from 2024-01-15 and again from 2024-08-15. So the 2024 lines matching EURX are rate coincidence, not conversion, and their impact is exactly 0.00.

analysis_tasks_no_extraction.task: Our impact figure of -1,223,730.83 USD uses only the first of the four baselines the organisation's own control implements: BSEG-DMBTR for WRTTP '54'. Extend it to the other three — the EKBE goods-receipt amount for PO reductions (WRTTP '51' / VRGNG 'RMBE' / BTART '0200'), the document's own KURSF including the negative indirect-quotation convention, and CONVERT_TO_LOCAL_CURRENCY at rate type M for everything else. Then split the population by WRTTP to see how much sits outside route 1.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.method: group the perimeter lines at EURX by WRTTP, VRGNG and BTART, then apply the matching baseline per group
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.why_it_matters: the difference between a figure for one value type and the figure the control actually produces
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.result: -4,178,499.57 USD across all routes. Route 2 turned out to have 191,181 lines system-wide, in FMIOI — the golden held that table as 13 of 69 columns, which is why it read as empty.

analysis_tasks_no_extraction.task: bkpf in the golden carries BUDAT but not WWERT, the translation date SAP uses for currency conversion when it is set. 155 of the 2024 zero-impact pairs post in months when the operational rate did not equal EURX, and WWERT would settle whether they used an earlier rate date. Re-pull bkpf with all fields.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.method: load_wide_tables.py with BKPF added to the plan, partitioned by GJAHR
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.why_it_matters: it is the last unexplained residual in the 2024 reading
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.result: bkpf re-pulled with all 122 columns. 416 of 422 pairs explained by the operational rate on WWERT, the other 6 by an explicit KURSF. The 2024 residual is closed and the coincidence reading is complete.

analysis_tasks_no_extraction.task: The budget rate's PERSONNEL side is computed in the HR PAYROLL SCHEMA and nothing extracted so far reaches it — the enhancements only show the seam, through YCL_FM_BR_PAYROLL_POSTING_BL and YCL_FM_BR_PBC_POSTING_BL. Read the payroll schema and its rules to find where the fixed rate is applied to staff cost, and establish whether its perimeter matches the non-personnel one or differs.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.method: read the schema and PCRs via T52C0/T52C5 and the HR schema tables, then trace how the result reaches YCL_FM_BR_PAYROLL_POSTING_BL
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.why_it_matters: half the mechanism is unmeasured, and staff cost is the largest single category of the organisation's spend
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.result: the GATE is HR feature YYCDR evaluated against PA0001, not a range. The two-step conversion (M to EUR, then EURX to USD) exists and is DEAD CODE behind IF 1 = 2. What runs is CONVERT_TO_CURRENCY_2 under WAERS='USD'. The trace table YTFM_BR_FM_POS is empty. The payroll SCHEMA itself is still unread.

analysis_tasks_no_extraction.task: Feature YYCDR decides which personnel numbers are in budget-rate scope. Read its decision tree — T549B/T549D and the feature's structure — and measure how many employees it returns 'Y' for. That IS the personnel perimeter, and it is currently unknown.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.method: read the feature definition, then evaluate its fields against PA0001 in the golden
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.why_it_matters: the non-personnel perimeter is 8 declared ranges; this one is undocumented
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.result: the tree is PERSG x GSBER='GEF' x WERKS, read from the compiled feature /1PAPA/FEAT350YYCDR. Groups 1 and 2 take five euro-zone areas, group 3 drops Belgium, group M keeps France only. 2,086 of 23,747 employees in scope — 8.8%, and 2,370 of the in-scope records are FR00.

analysis_tasks_no_extraction.task: The PBC budget-rate path writes its before/after trace through Y_FM_UPDATE_BR_FM_POS into YTFM_BR_FM_POS, and that table holds ZERO rows. Separate the two possible causes: the guarded branch is never reached (no PBC position in USD passing feature YYCDR), or the update task is not landing. The first is a scope fact, the second is a defect.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.method: count PBC positions by currency and cross against the feature's population
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.why_it_matters: an empty trace on a live mechanism and on a dormant one look identical
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.result: neither 'not reached' nor 'not landing'. The PAYROLL POSTING path ran six runs in JANUARY 2025 and stopped — 703 employees, 633 of them inside the YYCDR perimeter. The PBC POSITION path never wrote, because its calls are behind IF 1 = 2. Currency is not the blocker: PBC lines are USD on 1,207,981 rows.

analysis_tasks_no_extraction.task: The personnel budget rate produced amounts for six payroll posting runs in January 2025 and none since. Establish whether it was switched off deliberately, failed and was abandoned, or was a pilot that never went further. The payroll schema is the place to look — the FM side only records what arrives.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.method: compare the January 2025 runs against later ones in the payroll posting log, and read the schema for a switch or a date condition
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.why_it_matters: staff cost is the largest spend category and its budget-rate valuation stopped after one month, which is either a decision or a defect
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.result: it never started. Built, piloted for one month — six runs of 6/634/1/1/1/60 employees — and never adopted. The driver program has ZERO executions in the audit window while the control report has 43. User-confirmed: no real FI postings on that model.

analysis_tasks_no_extraction.task: BR for Staff is carried by 72 'Constant Dollar' wage types in country grouping UN. Establish three things: which payroll rule computes them (the schema layer does not name the mechanism, so it must be traced from the wage type backwards); whether they are configured to post, since T52EL returned nothing for MOLGA 'UN'; and what they amount to — the staff-cost equivalent of the -2,365,688.44 USD measured on the non-personnel side.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.method: trace each 9xxx wage type back through T512W processing classes and the rules that write it, then find the posting configuration for MOLGA UN
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.why_it_matters: staff cost is the largest spend category and this is the mechanism that values it at the budget rate. It is the last unmeasured half
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.result: ANSWERED, and the answer is that they are DORMANT: all 72 are configured in T512T/T512W/T52EL and ZERO of them post in 2026. The difference is carried by ONE wage type, 999S "SUM DIF Exch. rate Fluct.". Folded into AN-DORMANT-DESIGNED-CAPACITY.

analysis_tasks_no_extraction.task: YR00 is the main custom driver at 122 steps and calls a chain of schemas and rules. Trace the flow: which schemas run for which payroll areas, which rules they invoke, and where the custom logic sits against the SAP standard. That is the A_PROCESS cell for payroll and it is currently PARTIAL on an inventory alone.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.method: walk T52C1 from YR00 following COPY and PIT steps, resolving rules in T52C5
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.why_it_matters: an inventory is not a process; the flow is what makes it usable

analysis_tasks_no_extraction.task: Combine three streams that are each already held: the EXECUTION LOG (who ran what and when, 15.6M audit rows), the PBC output (FMRESERV change documents, 6.4M headers, and the HRM1/HRM2 commitment lines in FMIOI), and the FI DOCUMENT HEADERS (bkpf, now 122 columns including WWERT and KURSF). Joining them gives the chain from a payroll RUN to the documents it produced, with the person or channel that triggered it — which none of the three answers alone.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.method: attribute payroll posting runs from the audit log to their FI documents via BKPF creation stamps and the PBC commitment lines, in the manner of A8
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.why_it_matters: it turns 'payroll posted' into 'this run, by this actor, produced these documents' — the level at which a control or an anomaly is actionable
analysis_tasks_no_extraction._origin: user: combining the execution logs with PBC and the FI document headers is powerful
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.result: the chain is BKPF.AWKEY = PPDHD.DOCNUM (AWTYP HRPAY) backwards through PPDIX to PPOIX, which carries the wage type and the amount. Verified by arithmetic: a PPDIT line of 46.80 is 10.96 + 35.84 of PPOIX. The run-level reading of that chain is what exposed the simulations.

analysis_tasks_no_extraction.task: Generalise the finding into a detector. For every change-document object, compare the TRANSACTION CODES its maintainers use. Where one user reaches an object through SE38 or a generic route while every other uses a dedicated transaction, that is a CHANNEL DIFFERENCE — and it makes the action invisible to controls built around the transaction. Two instances are already measured: A_SEFIANI on NRINTERVAL and P.IKOUNA on IDENTITY.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.method: group cdhdr_history by OBJECTCLAS and TCODE, flag users whose route differs from the modal route for that object
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.why_it_matters: it finds bypasses without needing a policy document — the population of maintainers defines the norm
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.result: built as ALGORITHM A17. Two kinds emitted: SOLE_USER_OF_A_GENERIC_ROUTE and GENERIC_ROUTE_IS_THE_NORM — the second is the stronger and the first version missed it. NRINTERVAL is the case: SE38 is the modal route among 18 maintainers.

analysis_tasks_no_extraction.task: SETS and FMFCTR are changed in production and appear in ZERO transports, while T003 shows the intended pattern with zero production changes and 8,646 transport entries. Enumerate every configuration-like object with production changes and no transport history, and separate the ones that SAP does not transport by design from the ones that should have.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.method: cross cdhdr_history OBJECTCLAS against cts_objects by object type
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.why_it_matters: the hierarchies that the whole organisational roll-up depends on are in the first group
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.result: BANK 4,588 changes by 6 maintainers, ADRESSE3 3,898 by 19, COND_A 3,004 by 8, DEBI 1,874 by 15, BUPA_BUP 1,231 by 10, PROJ 1,050 by 12 — changed in P01 and never transported. Business documents excluded by volume and maintainer count.

analysis_tasks_no_extraction.task: Transported table CONTENT rose tenfold from September 2025 on an unchanged transport cadence, and it is mostly the generated authorisation layer — AGR_TIMEB, USR10, USR11, UST12 — plus the HR form-scenario tables. Separate the legitimate from the avoidable: role generation properly carries its generated entries, but a tenfold rise is a change in practice, not in policy. Establish what changed in September 2025 and which of these objects could be maintained rather than moved.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.method: re-extract cts_transports WITH as4text, then group the September-2025-onward transports by text pattern and owner
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.why_it_matters: this is IT intervening in content so the process runs — the pattern the user wants reduced, now sized and dated
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.result: mostly legitimate. Of 1,894 TABU objects since 2024: HR form scenarios 492, generated authorisations 461, directory/IMG 178, HOLIDAY CALENDARS 137 in 12 transports. The tenfold rise is calendar and form maintenance for a global organisation, not IT moving master data. The tail — T552A, TVARVC, T527O at one object per transport — is where anything remains.

analysis_tasks_no_extraction.task: BR for Staff is now fully described — 72 wage types, feature YYCDR over 2,086 employees, posting configuration in T52EL — but its AMOUNT has never been measured. Compute the staff-cost equivalent of the -2,365,688.44 USD measured on the non-personnel side. The payroll results live in cluster tables, which RFC does not read directly, so establish the route first.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.method: start from the posted documents: HRPAY FI documents carry 49,577 headers, and the symbolic accounts PADJ/OTHO/LANG/HOUS/TERM name the GL side
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.why_it_matters: the last unmeasured half of the mechanism, on the largest spend category
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.result: USD 20,523,434.48 and EUR 8,057,168.94 for 2026 to July, posted to dedicated 999 accounts by ONE wage type (999S) and netting to exactly zero per currency. The 72 Constant Dollar wage types are configured and DORMANT — zero of them post. SUPERSEDED by AN-PAYROLL-FI-RECONCILIATION below: this figure summed ALL payroll postings including simulations; the real posted-only 2026 impact is USD 1,982,154.59 / EUR 796,418.86 (claim #467, still netting to exactly zero). Mechanism findings (999S, dormancy) stand; only the amount was corrected.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.next_step: the account determination is now understood: the FI transaction key is the coarse bucket and the wage type picks the GL account inside it. To get the AMOUNT, join the payroll results to PPDIT so each Constant Dollar wage type's line is named, then sum. PPOIX is the missing join and it did not load — PPDIX short-dumped with TSV_TNEW_PAGE_ALLOC_FAILED, so it needs slicing by period rather than by company code

analysis_tasks_no_extraction.task: PPDIT 2026 shows tens of millions on the 999 accounts while the FI extract shows hundreds of thousands. Part of that is that bseg_union holds only 536,380 rows for 2026 against ~2.2 million for a full year, but the gap is larger than the coverage shortfall explains and it is NOT rationalised here.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.method: complete the 2026 FI extract first, then reconcile PPDHD documents to their FI counterparts and measure how much of the payroll posting reaches FI at all
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.why_it_matters: it is the difference between 'the impact is 20.5M USD' and 'the impact posted to FI is something else'. Until it is measured the figure is stated on the payroll posting side only
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.result: the gap is SIMULATION RUNS. 1,828 of 2,316 runs never post to FI and the cut is per run, never partial. The real 2026 impact is USD 1,982,154.59 and EUR 796,418.86 — my earlier figure was ninefold too high. VIEW payroll_runs_posted added to the golden.

analysis_tasks_no_extraction.task: a pattern is now visible three times: 72 Constant Dollar wage types configured and never posting; ZZSUBST_AUART and ZZSUBST_SPPRC built and never populated; the PBC conversion fully implemented behind IF 1 = 2. Inventory the DESIGNED-BUT-DORMANT capacity across the installation.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.why_it_matters: we are designing a future solution and these are pre-built fields and mechanisms it could use. The user asked for exactly this: identify every custom field and how it is used EVEN IF EMPTY TODAY
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.result: inventory in brain_v2/dormant_capacity.json. Five kinds. The headline is the PRPS block: 13 YYE_* fields that together form a programmatic and donor classification of the WBS element, built and holding almost nothing (max fill 0.61% of 60,292). Dormancy is the norm here.

analysis_tasks_no_extraction.task: ZZSUBST_KOMOK moves a payroll line off the SUSP suspense account onto a real symbolic account, 2,627 times in 2026 across a handful of employees. WHERE that is performed is unknown: the field appears in no extracted source file and the standard indicators PPDIT-SUBST and PPDIT-BADI_SUBST are empty on all 4,046,412 rows, so the standard substitution BAdI is not what runs.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.method: find the append structure on PPOIX via DD03L/DD02L, then the where-used of that structure; or scan the payroll posting programs and their enhancements for the field name
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.why_it_matters: it is a correction path that repairs failed account determination, and we do not know what triggers it or who controls it

analysis_tasks_no_extraction.task: the PRPS YYE_* block is a complete programmatic and donor classification of the WBS element that holds almost nothing. Find out WHEN it was built, by which transport, and whether anything ever filled it — the few hundred filled rows may name the pilot.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.method: the 367 rows with YYE_POC and 323 with YYE_COOP_AGENCY are the population to look at; cross them against the transport record (E070/E07T) and the change log
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.why_it_matters: we are designing a future solution and this is the single largest block of pre-built extension points found. Knowing what it was FOR decides whether to adopt it or replace it
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.result: not one dormant layer but 31 fields in THREE lifecycles: YYE_DONOR abandoned over 24 years (82%->5%), YYE_COOP_AGENCY a 2016-2020 pilot with 3 values, YYE_POC NEW and growing since 2022 (a flag 'X', one author). Ten more fields looked 100% filled because numeric fields default to zero — A18's emptiness test fixed.

analysis_tasks_no_extraction.task: YYE_DONOR fell from 82% of new WBS elements in 2002 to 5% in 2026, almost monotonically. It was the practice and something replaced it. Find what — the candidate is the fund side, where FMFINCODE carries ZZOUTPUT and the C/5 link.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.why_it_matters: a 24-year migration nobody documented. The new design needs to know which carrier won and whether the old one still has to be read for history
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.result: NOTHING displaced it. FMFINCODE-SPONSOR (0.2%) and Grants Management (GRANT_NBR empty over 2.3M lines) both refuted. What happened is that MULESOFT took over WBS creation in 2024 (85%) and fills execution modality, a constant 'UNESCO', and a Core Planner workplan code — none of which is the donor. The funding-source dimension left the SAP master.

analysis_tasks_no_extraction.task: YYE_POC is a flag holding 'X', empty before 2022 and growing since — 22, 19, 104, 144, 78 — filled by a single user. Something began in 2022. Find out what it marks.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.method: the 367 flagged WBS elements are a small, concrete population; look at what they share
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.why_it_matters: the only custom field on the WBS element being ADOPTED right now, which makes it the live edge of the model rather than an artefact
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.result: it marks project ROOTS (363 of 367 STUFE=1, extrabudgetary) arriving through the new Core Planner path with the COMPLETE classification block — including a properly-named donor (19 chars, 148 distinct, matching the Core Planner's list) against 8-char abbreviations elsewhere. Rollout 0%->26%->32% of new XB roots; by hand 2022-23, MULESOFT from 2024.

analysis_tasks_no_extraction.task: the donor dimension is no longer carried on the SAP WBS element and no SAP object replaced it. The plausible home is the Core Planner / PPM, which is also the source of the workplan codes now arriving in YYE_BENEF1 via MULESOFT. Confirm where the funding source is actually held, and whether SAP can still answer 'who funded this'.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.method: ADR-007 applies — the PPM brain owns that data and we consume it read-only. Ask via the ecosystem manifest rather than extracting; and check what the MULESOFT interface payload carries beyond the three fields it writes
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.why_it_matters: 'who funded this project' is a question the SAP model can no longer answer from master data, and a future design has to know whether that is acceptable or a gap to close
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.result: the donor did NOT leave SAP — it left the PROJECT master. In SAP it is the CUSTOMER master (5,401 of 12,517 KNA1, 43.1%, in six donor account groups). In the Core Planner it is a first-class role (5,777 rows over 2,738 workplans). The SF-to-SAP feed goes to BW (ZGMSPNSR), never to ECC's FM — which is why FMFINCODE-SPONSOR is 0.2%.

analysis_tasks_no_extraction.task: the flagged share of new extrabudgetary project roots rose 6% -> 26% -> 32% and then stopped at 31%. Two thirds of new XB roots still arrive without the complete classification. Find what distinguishes the two thirds — a project type, a sector, an office, or a Core Planner workflow status that never completes.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.why_it_matters: the mechanism works; the question is only coverage. Knowing what blocks the other two thirds is the difference between extending a working path and designing a new one

analysis_tasks_no_extraction.task: SEVEN of eleven projects have NO git remote: bsp-crp, ecosystem-coordinator, FINCLOSSING, Salesforcetesting, sapilot, SCRP, unescore20-PPM-brain. Their history exists on this disk plus a bundle on D:. A bundle survives a disk failure; it does not survive losing both disks, and it carries only COMMITTED history.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.state_s098: ecosystem-coordinator is READY: its two loose files are committed and the internal IP, the D01/P01 DNS names and the internal domain have been redacted to placeholders (commit 16fbd97), so it can take a remote safely. The others have NOT been reviewed for internal detail.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.blocked_by: gh is not installed on this machine, and creating a repository publishes UNESCO governance material to a personal GitHub account — that is the owner's decision, not the agent's.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.method: create each repo PRIVATE at github.com/new, then `git remote add origin` and `git push -u origin master`. BEFORE any of the other six: run the same content scan that found the IP and the DNS name in the coordinator — filenames prove nothing, and the DNS name was more sensitive than the IP and was not in the initial substitution list.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.why_it_matters: FINCLOSSING (15 uncommitted files), SCRP (4) and unescore20-PPM-brain (7) also hold work that no bundle covers, because a bundle carries only committed history.

execution_backlog._meta_tasks_design: Added 2026-07-26. The three sections above serve Layer 15 — the BUSINESS capability model. hypotheses_from_operator_memory.hypothesis: FUND RESERVATIONS ARE USED AS A ROLLING HOLD. The organisation reserves funds and then ADJUSTS the reservation MONTH BY MONTH specifically so the funds are never released. If true, the earmarked-funds mechanism is not a commitment instrument here — it is a budget-retention instrument, which is a different thing with different audit consequences.
hypotheses_from_operator_memory.why_it_is_credible_before_measuring: it would explain the single largest signal in the whole system: FMRESERV is the biggest change-document class at 6,415,467 headers over 2024-01..2026-03. A create-once commitment does not generate that volume. CONTINUOUS ADJUSTMENT does.
hypotheses_from_operator_memory.method: measure the change CADENCE per reservation document, not the volume. For each OBJECTID in cdhdr/cdhdr_history where OBJECTCLAS='FMRESERV': count distinct months with a change, the gap distribution between changes, and the lifetime. A rolling hold shows as many documents with a change in almost every month of their life and few final closures. Then cross to fmioi to see whether the AMOUNT moves down in step with consumption (a genuine commitment drawdown) or is topped back up (a hold).
hypotheses_from_operator_memory.data_on_hand: cdhdr 6.4M FMRESERV headers + fmioi 2,190,893 commitment lines — enough
hypotheses_from_operator_memory.connects_to: A10 found fmioi carries FONDS/FISTL/FIPEX at 100% and no MEASURE, so the reservation sits on the same two-legged address as everything else
hypotheses_from_operator_memory.source: operator recollection, s098 — to be validated, never cited as measured
hypotheses_from_operator_memory.result: RETENTION confirmed, MONTHLY refuted. Documents living >=6 months are touched in 32% of their months (median 6 changes), and lifetimes spike at 13 and 25 months — the biennium. So reservations are carried to the end of a budget period rather than consumed and closed. The naive all-documents ratio of 0.96 was an artifact of single-month lives.
hypotheses_from_operator_memory.still_open: whether the AMOUNT is drawn down or restored — the difference between a commitment and a hold. Needs per-document amounts from fmioi, or CDPOS values which are deferred by standing decision.

hypotheses_from_operator_memory.hypothesis: THE BUDGET-RATE SOLUTION HAS A SECOND, SEPARATE PATH FOR PERSONNEL, running through HR PAYROLL POSTING and BCM rather than through the main FI path.
hypotheses_from_operator_memory.why_it_is_credible_before_measuring: this is the strongest of the recollections because the code already shows its shape. YCL_FM_BR_EXCHANGE_RATE_BL has THREE gates, and CHECK_CONDITIONS_2 is explicitly the STAFF gate: it accepts EUR *and* USD (the main gate accepts EUR only) and it INCLUDES HRM1/HRM2/HRP1 — the PBC pre-commitment, PBC commitment and payroll transactions the main gate excludes. So a separate personnel path is not a guess; it is in the class. AND IT MAY BE DEAD: MR_HKONT is declared at line 57 and never populated, and an empty range makes IN false, so whenever a GL account is passed that gate fails always.
hypotheses_from_operator_memory.method: AN-BR-HKONT-EMPTY-RANGE first — establish whether callers pass IV_HKONT. If they do, the personnel BR path is closed on that condition and staff amounts were never converted. Then trace the payroll-posting side: which document types reach FI from HRM1/HRM2/HRP1 and at which rate they were valued.
hypotheses_from_operator_memory.data_on_hand: the class is read from P01; the 12 ZFIX enhancements are NOT — EXT-ENHO-SOURCE is blocked, and the enhancements are where the steps live
hypotheses_from_operator_memory.source: operator recollection, s098 — to be validated, never cited as measured

hypotheses_from_operator_memory.hypothesis: THE BUDGET-RATE CUSTOM IS NOT ONE CONVERSION — it is MULTIPLE STEPS applied at different points along the budget cycle, and FUND RESERVATION is one of those points.
hypotheses_from_operator_memory.why_it_is_credible_before_measuring: the family is 18 objects (5 classes, 1 composite ENHC, 12 ENHO) hooked at different places, which is the shape of a multi-step mechanism rather than a single exit. And CHECK_CONDITIONS_3 is the DELETION complement used during RFFMREPO reconstruction — evidence that the mechanism participates in rebuild, not only in posting.
hypotheses_from_operator_memory.method: map each of the 12 enhancements to its hook point and order them along the cycle: budget entry -> reservation -> commitment -> actual -> reconstruction. Requires the ENHO sources, which is EXT-ENHO-SOURCE. Until then the step order is inferred from the enhancement NAMES and their spots, and must be labelled INFERRED.
hypotheses_from_operator_memory.data_on_hand: brain_v2/budget_rate_enhancements.json holds the family; the sources do not
hypotheses_from_operator_memory.source: operator recollection, s098 — to be validated, never cited as measured

hypotheses_from_operator_memory.hypothesis: COST RECOVERY, THE BUDGET STRUCTURE, AND THE CORE-MANAGER-TO-FM-AND-PS FLOW ARE ONE MECHANISM, not four subjects that happen to touch. Treating them separately is why each one looks incomplete on its own.
hypotheses_from_operator_memory.why_it_is_credible_before_measuring: three independent measurements already point the same way. The FM ledger posts on Fund x Fund Centre only, so PS never appears in FM and the two are joined by an identifier convention. Cost recovery is fund FUNCTION 3 with its own fund families and TYPE 311. And the workplan-to-SAP seam runs at 1.8 days median while human validation runs at 20.9 — so the flow is one pipeline with one slow human stage, not separate systems.
hypotheses_from_operator_memory.method: build the single end-to-end trace for a SAMPLE of workplans: Core Planner workplan -> allocation (Fund_Type__c) -> SAP fund -> project/WBS by identifier -> FM lines -> AVC bucket -> cost-recovery fund if any. One table, one row per workplan, every hop labelled with the carrier that made it. That single artefact IS the claim.

system_profile._design: THE UNESCO PROFILE — the base fact-sheet of the tenant: what SAP is installed, what is really implemented, what actually runs, and HOW it is operated. This is the FIRST thing a session (or an external reviewer) needs; the capability_model (L15) then says how well we KNOW each domain. Profile = the system; capability_model = our knowledge of it. _concept._one_line: The PROFILE is what the TENANT IS. The capability model is what WE KNOW about it. Two different questions about the same system — and the delta between them is the work.

_why_a_new_concept.trigger: s097 — an external Business Process Review asked 'which modules are implemented and which are actively used'. The brain could not answer it. It held the HOW (operating model: 80.6% external orchestration; 37 integration flows) and it held OUR KNOWLEDGE (capability_model: domain x 11 capabilities), but nowhere did it hold the WHAT: the tenant's own footprint. The answer had to be re-derived live from cvers + audit logs and was wrong on 6 modules (RE-FX, SD, FI-AA, PM, TRM, PBC) plus an entire missing category (third-party add-ons).
_why_a_new_concept.diagnosis: Those 6 were not unknown — they were UNADDRESSED. PBC was in the brain as an 'engine' inside a prose doc; RE-FX had a domain folder; the add-ons had a companion. Knowledge existed but was not KEYED on the question being asked. A store you cannot query by the question you are asked is not knowledge, it is storage.
_why_a_new_concept.principle: CP-001 traceability + CP-003 evidence. A concept earns its place when a whole CLASS of question has no home. 'What is this tenant?' is that class.

_definition.profile: The measured reality of ONE tenant/system landscape: what is installed, what is configured, what is productive, how it is operated, who uses it, and through which channels data enters and leaves.
_definition.keyed_on: SAP APPLICATION COMPONENT (the technical module: FI-AA-AA, PA-PM-PB, RE-FX-CN...). This is deliberately a DIFFERENT axis from the capability model's canonical domain key.
not_the_profile: our coverage/knowledge of a domain -> that is capability_model (L15)
object-level graph -> that is L1 objects
an opinion, a roadmap or a recommendation -> the profile carries FACTS with evidence only

_evidence_tiers._rule: Every module MUST carry one of these. Never state a module without its tier — 'implemented' alone is the ambiguity that caused the s097 failure.
_evidence_tiers.INSTALLED: component present in CVERS. Near-meaningless on its own: 177 components are installed and most ship by default.
_evidence_tiers.CONFIGURED: organisational structure / customising exists (company code, sales org, plant, asset company code...).
_evidence_tiers.PRODUCTIVE: business documents exist AND/OR transactions are executed in the audit log.
_evidence_tiers.NOT_USED: the module exists but zero documents and zero executions — an ASSERTED negative, only valid when actually probed.
_evidence_tiers.NOT_EVIDENCED: we have no evidence either way. NOT the same as NOT_USED. Never collapse the two.
_evidence_tiers._adoption_is_a_separate_axis: Do NOT widen this vocabulary to express extent. The TIER answers 'how do we know?'; the optional `adoption` field (FULL/PARTIAL/MARGINAL) answers 'how far is it rolled out?'. Collapsing the two is what produced statuses like 'PARTIAL' that mean neither. Caught by the I1 gate on its first run — the gate paid for itself immediately.

_strata.note: The profile has three strata, in increasing order of what they cost to establish and of what they are worth.
_strata.1_footprint: installed / configured / productive per module + org structure. Cheap, factual, and the thing external parties always ask for first.
_strata.2_operation: HOW it is run: channel mix (dialog vs RFC vs IDoc vs batch vs file), who orchestrates, read vs write direction. This is where UNESCO's 80.6%-external headline lives.
_strata.3_periphery: what surrounds the core: third-party add-ons, the digital front-end (OData/Fiori), users and licences, and every channel through which data EXITS. Systematically forgotten, and the richest for a governance conversation.

_interrelations._design: The profile is not a leaf. It is the SPINE that the other stores hang off. Each link below is a LOOKUP (explicit key), never a fuzzy token match — the mistake ontology.json already had to correct once.
_interrelations.profile.module -> ontology.canonical_key: explicit `capability_domain` field per module. Resolves the technical module onto the canonical domain vocabulary.
_interrelations.profile.module -> capability_model.domai: via the above. Answers: for a module that is PRODUCTIVE, do we actually have capability coverage? A PRODUCTIVE module with no capability row is a SYSTEM-LEVEL BLIND SPOT — a different and more serious animal than the object-level blind_spots (L12), which are names we mentioned without a node.
_interrelations.profile.module -> claims: by domain + by related_objects. Every profile assertion must be traceable to a claim with evidence.
_interrelations.profile.module -> knowledge/domains/<x>/: the prose layer (artifact hierarchy: brain .md -> companion .html -> Word).
_interrelations.profile.operating_model -> knowledge/sys: the profile SUMMARISES; those docs stay the source of truth for per-flow detail. Never duplicate them here.
_interrelations.profile.third_party_addons -> F_INTERFAC: each add-on is an independent data-exit channel and therefore a governance object, not a licence line item.
_interrelations.profile -> capability_model: COMPLEMENTARY, NOT NESTED. Profile = the system. Capability model = our knowledge of it. Do not merge them; the delta between the two IS the backlog.

_module_to_domain._authority: EXPLICIT mapping, hand-maintained. `null` = no canonical domain exists yet -> that is a finding, not an error. s097: PBC/FI_AA/PM/SD/TRM/CO mapped to new same-named capability rows after the crossing exposed them as system-level blind spots.

_invariants.I1: Every module carries an evidence tier AND its evidence string. No tier without evidence.
_invariants.I2: NOT_USED requires an actual probe. Absence in the Gold DB or in executed_objects_domain_map is a FLOOR, never an inventory — it yields NOT_EVIDENCED, never NOT_USED.
_invariants.I3: Technical component names are resolved from the system (TADIR -> TDEVC -> DF14L), never from memory.
_invariants.I4: The profile is rendered into BRAIN_INDEX.md at bootstrap. If a session has to re-derive the footprint, the profile has failed — fix the profile, do not answer from scratch.
_invariants.I5: The profile is TENANT-SCOPED. Nothing here is portable to another client; the CONCEPT and the build scripts are.

_maintenance.who_updates: NOTHING edits the profile by hand any more. It is COMPOSED from 18 components by brain_v2/system_profile/compose_profile.py (algorithm P1), each component bound to the algorithm that derives it.
_maintenance.how: run the analysis cycle; P1 composes at the end. A component reported MISSING names the algorithm to run. A component reported DECLARED is hand work that a human still owes and that must be redone on the next tenant.
_maintenance.gate: build_profile_links.py still FAILS LOUD on an invariant breach. P1 does not replace it — P1 says WHERE each part of the profile comes from, the links gate says whether the parts are consistent.
_maintenance._superseded: s097. This field previously read 'any session that measures something — EDIT unesco_system_profile.json'. That made the profile unreproducible on a second installation, which is the one thing the profile exists for.

_links._what_this_is: The PROFILE crossed against capability_model / ontology / claims / knowledge docs / companions. Read `system_level_blind_spots` first.

system_level_blind_spots._meaning: Modules the tenant runs IN PRODUCTION that have NO row in the capability model — i.e. our operating model has never looked at them. Distinct from L12 blind_spots (names without a graph node). These are the expensive ones.

capability_domains_without_a_profile_mod._meaning: The mirror gap: domains we model but never tied to a real module — either cross-cutting (Integration, Closing) or a modelling artefact to reconcile.

_model_graph._objective: Understand the MACRO profile THROUGH the details. Top-down alone is a fact-sheet; bottom-up is what makes it verifiable.
_model_graph._chain: object -> tadir_prog(DEVCLASS) -> tdevc(COMPONENT) -> df14l(PS_POSID) = SAP's own application component. Deterministic, no name guessing.

resolution._meaning: Which rung of the evidence ladder resolved each object. The DENOMINATOR matters: users, GL accounts, variants and synthesised concepts are not repository objects and can never carry an application component. Counting them as 'unresolved' measures the wrong thing — they are reported separately.
resolution._pct_meaning: of RESOLVABLE (repository) objects, not of all nodes

coherence._meaning: Does the macro assertion survive contact with the detail? A module asserted PRODUCTIVE with nothing modelled underneath is the model believing its own summary.

cross_cutting._meaning: Domains that span modules instead of owning one. They are not gaps in the module axis — they are a different KIND of domain, and each one enriches every module it touches.
